trans-unit.source: This is expert level. You will barely see the taxiway from the cockpit, even if you are on ground. Fog and light drizzle, freezing level at 1000ft.
trans-unit.target: This is expert level. You will barely see the taxiway from the cockpit, even if you are on ground. Fog and light drizzle, freezing level at 1000ft.

trans-unit.source: With just a 1/4 mile visibility and clouds at 100ft, you don't see much of the runway until seconds before touchdown. Trust your instruments to stay alive.
trans-unit.target: With just a 1/4 mile visibility and clouds at 100ft, you don't see much of the runway until seconds before touchdown. Trust your instruments to stay alive.

trans-unit.source: The center of a high pressure region, characterized by descending air and hence only weak cloud development with high visibility.
trans-unit.target: The center of a high pressure region, characterized by descending air and hence only weak cloud development with high visibility.

trans-unit.source: The core of a low pressure region, characterized by overcast clouds, bad visibility on the ground and significant rainfall.
trans-unit.target: The core of a low pressure region, characterized by overcast clouds, bad visibility on the ground and significant rainfall.

trans-unit.source: Fog developed this autumn's morning. Expect good visibility above the layer. However - getting through it can be a challenge. Stay alive for a 500' climb and you'll see the sun!
trans-unit.target: Fog developed this autumn's morning. Expect good visibility above the layer. However - getting through it can be a challenge. Stay alive for a 500' climb and you'll see the sun!

trans-unit.source: A lovely day for trip to your favorite 100$ hamburger airfield
trans-unit.target: A lovely day for trip to your favorite 100$ hamburger airfield

trans-unit.source: A high pressure region, characterized by moderate to strong Cumulus development in the afternoon and fairly good visibility conditions.
trans-unit.target: A high pressure region, characterized by moderate to strong Cumulus development in the afternoon and fairly good visibility conditions.

trans-unit.source: A standard atmosphere model for testing and calibrating aircraft performance and design.
trans-unit.target: A standard atmosphere model for testing and calibrating aircraft performance and design.

trans-unit.target: A low pressure region, characterized by rising air, widespread formation of stratiform clouds and beginning rain.
